status: internal time-stamped analysis freeze before any formal model evaluation; not public preregistration

clinical.target: hospital mortality after the 24-hour ICU landmark
clinical.scope: adults still in their first ICU stay of a hospital admission at 24 hours; one hash-selected eligible admission per patient
clinical.eligibility: age >=18; ICU outtime and hospital discharge after landmark; known hospital outcome; MIMIC death time, when present, after landmark
clinical.patient_sampling: first ICU per hospital admission before eligibility; among eligible admissions choose lowest SHA256('6201:'+stay_id), then stay_id; never interpret identifiers as chronology
clinical.age: MIMIC anchor_age + ICU year - anchor_year, capped at 90; eICU >89 maps to 90; all ages capped at 90
clinical.sex: female=1 male=0 otherwise missing; no gender-based cohort exclusion
clinical.lab_selection: median of unique finite positive values measured in [0,24h], with nonmissing availability time also in [0,24h]; unit whitelist only; unknown unit excluded and counted; no outcome-dependent clipping
clinical.mimic_join: subject_id and selected ICU interval; accept missing hadm_id when time matches, otherwise require matching hadm_id
clinical.development: MIMIC-IV 3.1 patient-disjoint 60/20/20 splits, three seeds; stratified by outcome
clinical.external: eICU-CRD 2.0; never used for model, hyperparameter, feature or calibration selection
clinical.primary_metric: external Brier loss, hospital-cluster bootstrap percentile 95% CI for seed6201; patient bootstrap sensitivity
secondary: no lab versus some lab missingness
clinical.availability_sensitivity: apply the already selected strict model to measurement-time-only aggregates; descriptive comparison, not an admissible deployment model

nhanes.target: measured LBXGH HbA1c (%) in adults >=18 with observed outcome
nhanes.development: 2013-14 and 2015-16 combined; participant-disjoint 60/20/20 splits stratified by cycle; seeds6201/6202/6203
nhanes.external: 2017-18, not used in development or calibration; no repeat participants assumed across NHANES cross sections
nhanes.primary_metric: external RMSE, paired participant bootstrap percentile95% CI at seed6201, conditional empirical cohort inference
secondary: MEC-weighted RMSE and MAE as descriptive summaries only, no national population inference

models.preprocessing: training medians, all-feature missing indicators, training StandardScaler; saved complete pipeline; no test refit
models.constant: training prevalence or mean, one parameter-free baseline
models.linear: 9 regularization candidates: logspace(-4,4,9), inverse penalty C for logistic; alpha for Ridge
models.hgb: 9 candidates Cartesian learning_rate .03/.1/.2 by leaves7/15/31; max_iter150, l2_regularization1, early_stoppingFalse
models.gate: new additive logistic-gate basis, not reproduction of published LGO GP; unique training quantiles .2/.5/.8 for nonbinary features; raw standardized binary features and missing indicators as linear terms; 3 slopes .5/1/2 by regularization .1/1/10; logistic link for mortality, identity for HbA1c
models.gate_ablation: single gate at training median per continuous feature, same9 slope/regularization candidates
models.selection: minimum validation Brier or RMSE; lexicographic candidate order resolves ties; fit training only, keep selected fit, no calibration or train+validation refit
models.information_budget: same data, split, features, imputation,9 validation candidates per tunable family; matched candidate count not matched compute or capacity

audit.truth_separation: auditor sees artifacts, declared claim scope, registered reference and unlabeled probes only; fault type and expected outcome held by scoring harness
arms: B1 conventional independent artifact integrity + numerical replay + scope checks
B2 component checks without cross-artifact dependency binding
audit.challenges: clean and semantic-preserving term reorder/comment changes; scope-only mismatch; gate-coordinate mismatch; coefficient mismatch; stale model paired with newer reference; out-of-probe functional perturbation; metadata forgery that leaves numeric predictions identical; deterministic fixed grid of magnitudes .05/.2/1 and 10 probe seeds
audit.interpretation: finite software fault challenge; report per-family rates, benign retention and runtime; no sensitivity to all real-world faults; strong B1 may match Full; hash is content binding, not a trusted external signature
audit.prediction_control: same predictor with and without audit must have identical clean predictions; report this zero increment explicitly; restoration only from retained reference artifacts, never labels

ontology: inspect final system lineage and prepare genuinely new concept split; do not call old cache rescoring a third independent experiment; if resource cost exceeds scope, prioritize these two complete externally validated applications
